newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil coffee coops report slightly warmer temps.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee coops report slightly warmer temps.

text.p: Key Brazilian coffee regions saw another cold night but cooperatives and weather centres in critical areas all reported slightly warmer early morning temperatures by 0530 local/0830 GMT than seen on Monday with no initial reports of frosts.
On Monday, frosts formed in low-lying areas where coffee is not grown but did not reach the higher coffee farms which normally see milder temperatures than those registered in the towns.
Weather forecasters have forecast any frosts this morning would once again only occur in lower elevations with no damage expected for coffee.
Temperatures are now expected to pick up through the week as the polar air mass which has brought the chilly weather moves out to sea.
